description: This Java interface defines a handler responsible for adding custom headers to a request, particularly within the context of a gateway route in the Ditto project. It specifies an enum for request types and a method that appends custom headers to default headers, returning a future containing the new headers.

classes.name: CustomHeadersHandler
classes.description: A Java interface for handling the addition of custom headers to request contexts in a gateway service.

methods.name: handleCustomHeaders
methods.description: Adds custom headers to the provided default DittoHeaders and returns a CompletableFuture containing the combined headers.
